# Restore the repository's documented behavior

The implementation in `/workspace/repo` has drifted from the repository's checked-in,
solver-visible behavioral documentation in one or more places. Investigate the
repository broadly, determine which documented behavior is no longer implemented
correctly, and restore the implementation to match its existing public specification.

Do not rewrite the documentation or invent new requirements. Preserve public APIs,
signatures, supported behavior, and file layout while making the necessary implementation
changes. Edit existing implementation files only; do not add implementation files.
Work offline and treat the checked-in behavioral documentation as the authority.

The upstream test suite and upstream Git history are intentionally not supplied.
Use the provided runtime and installed dependencies to investigate, and write your own local checks as needed.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workspace/repo/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards.
